user.title: New irrigation system
user.description: Name the system. You can create more than one: garden, vegetable patch, greenhouse.

zone.title: Zone {number}
zone.description: Pick the zone valve and its base duration. The duration stays editable from the dashboard.

master.title: Master valve or pump
master.description: Many systems have a main valve upstream of the zones, or a relay that starts a pump. If yours does not, leave the box unticked.

data.use_master: This system has a master valve or a pump

master_details.title: Master: entity and delays
master_details.description: The master opens AFTER the zone and closes BEFORE it: pressurising a pump against closed valves causes water hammer and trips the pressure switch. The 3 second defaults are fine in most cases; raise them if the valves are slow.

rain.title: Rain source
rain.description: How the system decides that watering is not needed.

rain_details.title: Rain settings
rain_details.description: With a numeric sensor or a forecast, the cycle is skipped when millimetres exceed the threshold. With a binary_sensor, being on is enough.

abort.already_configured: A system with this name already exists.

zone.title: Zone {number}
zone.description: Zones are declared again from scratch: confirm or correct each one, then untick to finish.
